notes.title: Halloween Sale going on!
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

As part of Steam's Halloween sale, we will be offering a discount on The Thief Girl.

In The Thief Girl, a pumpkin soldier appears as an enemy monster from stage 25.
Unlike normal enemies, if you are attacked by a pumpkin soldier, you will fail the mission at once.
It's an annoying thing that raises the difficulty of the game moderately.

If you are spotted, it will be difficult to complete the mission.
If you are found, it will be difficult to clear the mission, so please be careful not to be found while attacking the stage.

Thank you for your playing!

notes.title: "The Thief Girl" product version has been released!
notes.notes:
"Thief Girl" is a stealth action game where you collect treasure chests and aim for the goal without being found by monsters.

Product version contains 100 missions.
There are many stages in the second half where it is difficult to complete the S rank.
Let's try it!

In addition, demo version is also updated. 
You are welcome to try it too!
